reason: I don't see rupees coming back into my till from this, it just promises to tidy things I already manage. A wrong order card that I tap by mistake costs me a customer, and that costs more than 500 a month.
objection: What if it writes the wrong order and I lose a customer's trust? Hindi voice notes and phone calls are messy, and I'd end up checking every card myself anyway, so where is the saving?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run on my own real orders for a couple of weeks, with a written promise that I pay nothing if it logs wrong orders or I can't show it saved me money.
